correctness.rationale: Directed-edge strong Markov decomposition H=zq+z(1-q)HB and B=zr+z(1-r)HB gives an exact quadratic valid even with escapes. Selecting the unique analytic branch yields H(1)=q/(1-r), and differentiation yields E[T|return]=2(d-1)/(d-2). Factored discriminant has unique dominant square-root singularity at lambda^-2 with lambda<1 and positive coefficient, giving the stated asymptotic. Exact rational direct radial-chain propagation and independent coefficient expansions agreed on 660 finite-time values, plus 60 identities/range checks (720 total). Singular endpoints are excluded.

value.rationale: The exact first-return generating function for a genuinely memory-dependent graph walk is a natural observable left unresolved by a qualitative recurrence criterion. Its conditional first-return mean is completely independent of the memory weight, whereas the probability of ever returning and the exponential rate of rare return times change with that weight; this contrast cannot be inferred from ordinary simple-walk formulas alone. The full law applies to all positive weights and all d>=3 and is relevant to temporal exploration and repeated visits in network random walks.
